assets.name: M1_Horn
assets.notes: 6 sails in 3 pairs round a hollow walk-in core; mouths (A-frames 16 x 14) at 60/180/300; inner sails 50 above the deck, outer 36. Pivot: deck centre (world y 52).
assets.pivot: base centre on the ground (see notes)

assets.name: M1_Platform
assets.notes: three-pointed star (triangle, points r 50 at 0/120/240, clipped), 6 high above the knoll (y 46 -> deck 52), embedded 1 stud; bronze steps (18 wide, 4 x 1.5) at the mouths. Pivot: knoll level.
assets.pivot: base centre on the ground (see notes)

assets.name: M1_Plinth
assets.notes: brushed steel drum 4.3 x 1.6 with a 0.25 copper top plate; hidden 0.8 below the turf. Pivot: turf.
